entities.summary: İmamoğlu is a municipality and district of Adana Province, Turkey. Its area is 445 km2, and its population is 27,037 (2022). It is an agricultural community on a small plain in the hills between the cities of Adana and Kozan, 45 km from Adana, 27 km from Kozan.
